text_block_list.text:
Today's the Satsuki Sho, the first race of
the
Classics.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Curses abound! O, woe is me! Woe is me!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
...And Голд Шипп is beside herself for
some
reason!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Why?! Why does it have to be like this?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
How dare you ask me that! There's only
one
reason why I'd be so distraught!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: But it makes no sense! "Satsuki" is "May" on the old Japanese calendar, and it's April right now!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
The audacity! The disrespect! How dare
they
spurn April?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Did they ever stop to consider April's
feelings?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I tell you, I won't stand for it! I'll win
today's race
for April's sake, no matter
what it takes!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
And when I do, I'm renaming it to "Uzuki
Sho" to
match the old Japanese
calendar!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
The thing is, the Satsuki Sho was
originally held in
May... but Голд Шип
storms off before I can
explain.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In any case, she sure is motivated. I'm
sure today's
race will go well! Probably!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
